//: Ceilings for the single-file shells. Raise one IN THE COMMIT that needs the bytes, and say what bought them. Checked by scripts/test-spaces-size.mjs.

spaces.//: 240 KiB. The whole spaces build-out in one branch: M3/M4 content work (tables, media, link cards, comments, export-page-as-space, subtree import), then the formatting UI (a properties panel, a selection toolbar with a real mark engine and a colour palette), a dark interface, a rebuilt About dialog, and a starter space that finally demonstrates all of it. 166,482 B before any of it and 238,862 B after. Six branches each measured a raise against a baseline none of them shared; this is measured on the stack, which is the only place the real figure exists. About a third of the growth is LANGUAGE — 473 strings x 8 locales — which is the honest cost of an app that opens in eight languages from one file. Zopfli is applied and is worth about 4% of it. Headroom is deliberate: the shell is mostly one compressed block and the packer's output differs across node versions (one commit measured 130,095 B on node 26 locally and 131,246 B on CI node 24), so a tight ceiling fails in CI for no reason.
